description: This file defines the module 'chart.js', including its version info, licensing, and a UMD wrapper for compatibility across different environments. It registers various chart types (bar, line, pie, doughnut, etc.), plugins, scales, and controllers used in the Chart.js library. The file serves as the entry point that initializes the Chart object, incorporates helpers, defaults, and various components to facilitate rendering different types of charts in web applications.

classes.name: Chart.DatasetController
classes.description: Base class for all dataset controllers (line, bar, etc). Responsible for managing element creation, updates, scaling, and event handling for a dataset.

classes.name: Scale
classes.description: Base class for all scale types in Chart.js. Provides common properties and methods for handling scale calculations, tick generation, and rendering.

classes.name: LinearScale
classes.description: Extends the base Scale class to implement linear scaling, including data limits calculation, tick creation, and data-to-pixel conversion for linear axes.

classes.name: LogarithmicScale
classes.description: Extends Scale to implement logarithmic scaling, managing special calculations for data limits, tick generation, and pixel mapping suitable for log scales.

classes.name: CategoryScale
classes.description: Implements categorical axes based on label arrays, managing label positioning, tick calculation, and data-to-pixel conversions for discrete categories.

classes.name: LinearRadialScale
classes.description: Handles radial (polar) linear scales for radar/spider charts, including radial coordinate calculations, point positioning, and scale fitting.

classes.name: TimeScale
classes.description: Manages time-based axes using Moment.js, providing methods to parse, generate, and interpolate date/time values, and dynamically adjust tick intervals based on data range.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the controller with the chart instance and dataset index, and links scales.

methods.name: updateIndex
methods.description: Updates the controller's dataset index.

methods.name: linkScales
methods.description: Links the controller to the appropriate scales, based on dataset and meta information.

methods.name: getDataset
methods.description: Returns the dataset associated with this controller.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the metadata object for this dataset.

methods.name: getScaleForId
methods.description: Returns the scale object for a given scale ID.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the element states to their initial state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and meta data when the controller is destroyed.

methods.name: createMetaDataset
methods.description: Creates the main dataset element (e.g., line or bar element).

methods.name: createMetaData
methods.description: Creates individual data elements (e.g., points, bars).

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Initializes the dataset and data elements within the meta data.

methods.name: addElementAndReset
methods.description: Adds a new data element at a specified index and resets its state.

methods.name: buildOrUpdateElements
methods.description: Ensures that the meta data elements reflect the current dataset, listening to array mutations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Placeholder for the update method, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Animates elements from previous to current state.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws all elements of the dataset.

methods.name: removeHoverStyle
methods.description: Restores element style from previous hover state.

methods.name: setHoverStyle
methods.description: Applies hover style to a given element.

methods.name: resyncElements
methods.description: Reconciles the number of meta data elements with the dataset length.

methods.name: insertElements
methods.description: Inserts new elements at a specified position.

methods.name: onDataPush
methods.description: Handles push (append) data events.

methods.name: onDataPop
methods.description: Handles pop (remove last) data events.

methods.name: onDataShift
methods.description: Handles shift (remove first) data events.

methods.name: onDataSplice
methods.description: Handles splice (remove and/or insert) data events.

methods.name: onDataUnshift
methods.description: Handles unshift (add at start) data events.

methods.name: determineDataLimits
methods.description: Calculates the minimum and maximum data values for the scale based on datasets, considering stacking and hidden data.

methods.name: buildTicks
methods.description: Generates an array of tick values based on data range, scale options, and desired tick count.

methods.name: getPixelForValue
methods.description: Converts a data value to its corresponding pixel position on the scale.

methods.name: getValueForPixel
methods.description: Converts a pixel position back to the corresponding data value.

methods.name: convertTicksToLabels
methods.description: Transforms the tick array into label strings for display.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating scale layout, including dimension calculations, label placement, and drawing.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Calculates and sets the optimal size of the scale, accounting for labels, tick marks, and other decorations.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the scale, grid lines, tick marks, and labels on the chart canvas.

methods.name: handleTickRangeOptions
methods.description: Adjusts the min and max scale limits based on user configuration options.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns the labels associated with the scale, which might come from dataset labels or extra label arrays (xLabels/yLabels).

methods.name: buildTicks
methods.description: Generates a maximum of `capacity` timestamps between min and max, rounded to the `minor` unit, aligned on the `major` unit and using the given scale time `options`.
